subject: Stones of the Sunlight
text: The Stones of the Sunlight are down a staircase located past a locked door on the right side of Tantagel Castle.

evidence.quote: While you are in Tantagel Castle, unlock the door that is guarding the right side of the castle. Go as far to the right as you can, one step right of the castle wall and walk downward to until you see a staircase. Go down that staircase and get the Stones of the Sunlight.

subject: Garninham
text: Three treasure chests can be collected behind a locked door inside Garninham.

evidence.quote: When you enter Garninham, go to the right until you see a locked door. Open the door and go in. Collect the three treasure chests.

subject: Grave of Garin
text: The hidden entrance to the grave in Garninham is located at the top left corner of the screen, roughly three or four steps from the left corner.

evidence.quote: In order to enter the grave, you will have to go to the top left corner of the screen and find the hidden entrance which is about three or four steps from the left corner

subject: Silver Harp
text: The Silver Harp is found in a treasure chest located in the middle of a big room at the bottom of the Grave.

evidence.quote: It is now time to retrieve that Harp!...You will be in a big room with a treasure chest in the middle. Take it and then die.

subject: Staff of the Rain
text: The old man in the Northern Cave trades the Staff of the Rain in exchange for the Silver Harp.

evidence.quote: go towards Kol to go to the Northern Cave as explained above. Trade the old man the harp for the Staff of the Rain.

subject: Green Dragon
text: The dragon guarding the princess in Swamp Cave is susceptible to sleep and fire breath inflicts 10-14 HP of damage.

evidence.quote: Now chant the spell of sleep. It may work and it may not. When it does, keep using the spell of hurt. When the dragon attacks, make sure you use an herb for your next move, unless he just breathes fire which only takes 10-14 HP.

subject: Princess Gwaelin
text: After defeating the dragon, Princess Gwaelin is rescued behind a locked door in Swamp Cave.

evidence.quote: When you beat him finally, heal yourself some more. Then go to the locked door, unlock it and talk to the princess. Say yes you will bring her home, exit the cave and go back

subject: Gwaelin's Love
text: Returning Princess Gwaelin to the king at Tantagel Castle rewards the player with Gwaelin's Love.

evidence.quote: When you get back, talk to the king and he will be grateful Gwaelin will give you a present....It is Gwaelin's love.

subject: Erdrick's Armor
text: Erdrick's Armor is found by defeating the Axe Knight and searching the ground in the small swamp next to a tree on the east side of Hauksness.

evidence.quote: Go to Hauksness, and heal yourself all the way running away from everything. Go to the east side of it where there is a tree and small swamp. Stand on the swamp right next to the tree and heal yourself. Now step on the square and the Axe Knight will appear....When you do, search the ground and you will now have the Erdrick's Armor.

subject: Axe Knight
text: The Axe Knight can be countered by casting Stopspell immediately, attempting sleep, and attacking with the Hurt spell and herbs.

evidence.quote: Now step on the square and the Axe Knight will appear. Chant the stopspell immediately. No pray he will chant it, wasting his attack. If he doesn't, use an herb. Then you should try to put him to sleep. If it doesn't work after 2 tries, screw it. Just keep fighting with hurt spell, and herbs, praying he will try to chant the sleep spell.

subject: Erdrick's Armor
text: Erdrick's Armor restores 1 HP with every step taken and prevents damage when walking on swamps.

evidence.quote: Cross that bridge and enter the huge swamp. You won't lose any power now because you have Erdrick's Armor....Remember, with Erdrick's Armor you heal one point every step so this will help too.

subject: Erdrick's Token
text: Erdrick's Token is hidden in the center of the right side of the huge swamp south of Hauksness, at coordinates 70 40 when using Gwaelin's Love.

evidence.quote: Go all the way to the other side of the swamp, running away from enemies and using herbs when needed when you get to the center of the right side of the swamp, or 70 40 if you use Gwaelin's love, search the ground and find Erdrick's Token.

subject: Rainbow Drop
text: The Rainbow Drop is obtained from an old man down a staircase south of Rimildar.

evidence.quote: Now go back to the Wyvern location south of Rimildar and go down the staircase. Talk to the old man there. Get the rainbow drop

subject: Rainbow Bridge
text: Using the Rainbow Drop while standing directly in front of the channel on the sand west of Rimildar creates a rainbow bridge.

evidence.quote: Now head for the Rimildar area again but instead of going south, go directly west until you are on sand and come to a channel. Stand right in front of the channel and select rainbow drop from the items menu....The lake will flash many different colors and you will hear lots of sounds. Then a bridge will appear.

subject: Charlock Castle
text: In Charlock Castle, searching directly behind the throne beyond the barrier reveals a secret staircase.

evidence.quote: to the north until you see barriers and a throne. Cross the barriers and walk directly behind the throne and search. A staircase will appear.

subject: Erdrick's Sword
text: Erdrick's Sword is found inside a treasure chest deep within the lower floors of Charlock Castle.

evidence.quote: When you go down the next staircase, you will see a treasure chest. Take the chest and you have the Erdrick's Sword.

subject: Golem
text: The Golem guarding Cantlin is countered by using the Fairy Flute to put him to sleep immediately whenever he wakes up.

evidence.quote: Go to the town and two steps before it you will see a Golem. First use the Fairy Flute to put him to sleep....Keep attacking him when he dies and when he wakes up, use the Fairy Flute immediately.

subject: Silver Shield
text: The Silver Shield can be purchased from a shop behind a locked door inside Cantlin.

evidence.quote: When you finally make enough money for the Silver Shield, go into Cantlin, and unlock the door that has two shops with your last key. Buy the Silver Shield

subject: Dragonlord
text: Talking to the Dragonlord prompts an offer to rule half the land; accepting ruins the game.

evidence.quote: Talk to him, using talk. He will offer you to rule half the land with him. Say no, or you will ruin the game and have to reset and leave from where you were before you went to the Castle.

subject: Dragonlord
text: When fighting the Dragonlord's true dragon form, attack and cast only Healmore to sustain HP until he is defeated.

evidence.quote: When he is dead, a huge dragon will appear and it will say "The Dragonlord revealed his true self." Do NOT under and circumstances try chant any other spell besides Healmore during this battle. Attack him, and he will attack you. When your life gets low, chant healmore. Keep sustaining and doing this until you defeat him.

subject: Level Cap
text: The highest level attainable is Level 30, requiring 4000 experience points per level, with a maximum cap of 65535 on both experience and gold.

evidence.quote: You will have to get 4000 points each level now. The highest level is 30. The highest experience and gold allowed is 65535.
